alt: Official CDSS SOC 825 — IHSS Protective Supervision 24-Hour Care Assessment
summary: The official California Department of Social Services (CDSS) SOC 825 form used by physicians and medical groups to certify severe cognitive or mental impairment in IHSS recipients, qualifying them for full 24-hour protective supervision care hours.
full_text:
STATE OF CALIFORNIA - HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES AGENCY CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES

PROTECTIVE SUPERVISION

24-HOURS-A-DAY COVERAGE PLAN
PLEASE PRINT
NAME OF IHSS RECIPIENT: RECIPIENTS TELEPHONE #

‘ADDRESS OF IHSS RECIPIENT:

NAME OF PRIMARY CONTACT RESPONSIBLE: CONTACT'S TELEPHONE #

RELATIONSHIP TO RECIPIENT:

As the primary contact for arranging the 24-hour-a-day coverage plan for the above named Recipient, | acknowledge my
understanding of the following:

e A 24-hour-a-day coverage plan has been arranged and is in place.
The continuous 24-hour-a-day coverage plan can be met regardless of paid In-Home Supportive Service (IHSS) hours
along with various alternate resources (i.e.; Adult or Child Day Care Centers, community resource centers, Senior
Centers, respite centers, etc.)

e The 24-hour-a-day coverage plan will be provided at all times.

e If there is any change to the 24-hour-a-day coverage plan (i.e. hospitalization, attendance in day-care programs,
travel, etc.) | will immediately notify the IHSS social worker.

e The above name Recipient has an established need for 24-hour-a-day Protective Supervision if he/she is to remain
safely in the home. The IHSS social worker has also discussed with me the appropriateness of out-of-home care as
an alternative to 24-hour-a-day Protective Supervision.

NAME OF CARE PROVIDER (1): CONTACT PHONE #
